hunyuan3d-2.loader: hy3dgen (Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2 runtime source): Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline.from_pretrained("$MODEL_ROOT/by-name/hunyuan3d-2", subfolder="hunyuan3d-dit-v2-0") and Hunyuan3DPaintPipeline.from_pretrained("$MODEL_ROOT/by-name/hunyuan3d-2", subfolder="hunyuan3d-paint-v2-0-turbo"), with an expanded absolute path so neither falls back to the Hub
notes: Licence: Tencent Hunyuan Community License (LICENSE and NOTICE in the alias). It does not apply in the EU, UK or South Korea, and needs a separate licence above 1 million monthly active users.

VRAM: upstream quotes about 6 GB for shape generation and 16 GB for shape plus texture. On an 8 GB GPU run shape alone, or free the shape pipeline before painting and call Hunyuan3DPaintPipeline.enable_model_cpu_offload(); the paint peak under offload is unmeasured. Reserve gpu-run --vram 8GiB for shape and at least 16GiB for texture until measured.

Paint loads unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.bin through unet/modules.py, so the alias keeps the .bin and omits the duplicate safetensors; the shape pipeline reads model.fp16.safetensors, its default variant.
Images without an alpha channel go through hy3dgen.rembg, whose rembg session downloads u2net on first use; pass RGBA input or a BiRefNet mask to stay offline.
